brady.subject: From your neighbor in Lake Forest
brady.body:
Hi Rick, this is Brady Schwartz from Paradise Home Design on Deerpath in Lake Forest, basically your neighbor. First real sales job out of high school for me, headed to USC for AI in the fall.

Paradise has been on Deerpath for 38 years, and they gave me a $5,000 credit I can put toward a kitchen or primary bath project booked off an in-home walkthrough this month. Free visit, sketches, real numbers, no pressure on the call.

The showroom at 225 E Deerpath is open if you want to see finishes in person first.

We come to you, fifteen minutes max. What's your availability look like this week?

- Brady Schwartz
Paradise Home Design Inc
brady@paradisehomedesigninc.com
See our work: paradisehomedesigninc.com/gallery.html
